text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After an outing with Dantsu Flame,
we noticed a crowd gathered in a corner.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there's a sign.
Let's see... a karaoke contest??

text_block_list.name: TV Reporter
Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wooww... Th-There are so many people.
I wonder if this cheesecake is really famous...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A massive crowd had gathered in front of the venue.
It seemed to be an even bigger event than imagined.

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Anyone who wants to join the karaoke contest,
please raise your hand~! First up is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The staff are picking participants one by one.
With so many people here, getting called on
will come down to catching their eye."

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yeeees! Present!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
"Next up, the gentleman in the green hoodie over there!
Anyone else~?"

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Hk, yes, yes!
I'm right here too~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems the little girl was blocked from view by the adult in front of her, making her invisible to the staff.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“—Um, hello there.
Do you love cheesecake too?”

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah! I love cheesecake and I love singing, so I really wanted to try it!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Still, no one's finding me at all.
Can they... not see me?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
! In that case, I'll give you a piggyback ride!
Then you can shout "Heeere!" at the top of your lungs, right?

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Then... the next person will be the last participant!
Anyone interested~?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
—Up we go.
Ready? Ready, gooooo!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu & Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yeeeeeeees!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Alright, you two over there!
Come on up to the front!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, no!
Not me, just this little one—

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Let's sing together, Big Sister!
I want to sing with you!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu & Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna shine right here, right now~♪
Someday I'll surpass my dreams and you too♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the girls finished singing—and the time came to announce the results.

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
"Claiming the glorious victory! And the one
who has won the exquisite cheesecake is..."

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Here are our final pair of singers!
Congraaaatulations!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ! W-Whoa, whoa...!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu & Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
We did it!
Yaaayyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Big Sis...
Do you really not want any cheesecake?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm fine.
My tummy's full right now, and besides—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not a big fan of cheesecake,
so I want you to eat my share too!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She's an unmatched cheese lover herself. Those words were surely spoken out of concern for the girl. But—

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...No way.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"I know that's a lie!
Because—"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey there, hello!
Do you like cheesecake too?”

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You love this too, right, Big Sis?
Since we're here, I want us to eat together!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ! B-But—
choice_data_list: I think it's okay to accept it.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Let's eat, Big Sister!
We won the championship together, after all!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Thank you.
Then... do you mind if I just have one slice?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
That cheesecake she gave me
was so delicious~. Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, she only took a single slice.
Surely that, too, was out of consideration for the young girl.
choice_data_list: Dantsu is so kind, isn't she?
Let's go buy a whole cheesecake next time.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
No, no. That's not the case.
It's just...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Something similar happened to me when I was little.
I was so happy that someone helped me back then.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Um, it's sort of like repaying a favor.
choice_data_list: I think that was a great way to repay them.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
! Fufu.
If that's the case... I'm really happy.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Are you sure?!
...The calories, though... um...
choice_data_list: As long as you exercise enough to make up for it, you'll be fine!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, you're right. In that caseâ
maybe I'll eat a whole bunch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though she acts like an older sister in front of children,
she's still an innocent young Umamusume herself.
I was reminded of that once again.
